description: Test file for the metrics package in Kubernetes pod security admission, containing unit tests for recording evaluation metrics, exemptions, and errors, as well as verifying metric outputs.

methods.name: TestRecordEvaluation
methods.description: Tests recording of evaluation metrics with various decision, mode, operation, level, version, and resource combinations.

methods.name: TestRecordExemption
methods.description: Tests recording of exemption metrics for different resources and operations.

methods.name: TestRecordError
methods.description: Tests recording of error metrics with different fatality flags and operations.

methods.name: levelVersion
methods.description: Creates a LevelVersion object with specified level and version string.

methods.name: expectCachedMetrics
methods.description: Ensures cached metrics are included in the expected output, adding zero-value samples if missing.

methods.name: addZeroExpectation
methods.description: Adds a zero-value sample for a metric if it is not already present in expectations.
